title: hypericum quadrangulum subsp. undulatum
intro: Hypericum quadrangulum subsp. undulatum, commonly known as wavy St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the St. John's Wort family (Hypericaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, as well as its antidepressant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to be due to its ability to modulate neurotransmitter levels and reduce oxidative stress, with reported effects including anxiolytic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of H. quadrangulum subsp. undulatum include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
